narrative.overview:
The site is a product catalogue of the kind Braun printed in the 1960s and 70s, with one product in it: a working Nokia 3310. Off-white paper, near-black type, a precise grid ruled with hairlines, the product as the exhibit, and spec-sheet captions in tabular figures. One functional colour, signal orange, is used like Braun's power marks: rarely, and only to say 'here' or 'on'.

The phone arrives as a technical drawing with dimension lines, and a fine rule sweeps down it turning it into the 3D phone, which lifts off the page and settles: the one authored moment. Refined, not skeuomorphic, and light only.
keyCharacteristics: The phone is the exhibit, at about its real size, uncovered.
One typeface, Archivo, tabular figures for data.
Hairline rules organise everything; an ink rule opens each table and list.
Signal orange only for the phone's place in the index, the sound lamp, focus and the caret.
Section numbers are the phone's menu numbers.

rules.name: The Power Mark Rule
rules.body: The signal colour marks state, never decoration, text or a region.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: No gradients, textures, glass or tinted panels; structure is rules and space.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Archivo for everything, the drawing's lettering included.

rules.name: The Top Line
rules.body: The index's rule, the phone's top and the heading's capitals share one line.

dos: Do keep the phone the exhibit: at most its real size, uncovered.
Do set new information as a spec row, caption or ruled list.
Do use tabular figures for data and the phone's menu numbers for sections.
Do name keys in the phone's terms first: Select (Enter).
Do keep the index plain, server-rendered links.
donts: Don't add a second accent, typeface, gradients, textures, glass, cards or rounded panels.
Don't put a kicker above a heading.
Don't animate anything else on load.
Don't turn on spec callouts without checking they clear the spread.
Don't reuse the desk's or template's old tokens.
